replication_question: Can EEG descriptors previously explored on propofol-sedation EEG (ds005620) generalize to an independent cohort with different hardware, montage, task, or acquisition protocol, without treating prediction as causation or consciousness evidence?

candidates.title: A repeated awakening study exploring the capacity of complexity measures to capture dreaming during propofol sedation
candidates.license: Unresolved conflict: CC0 in dataset_description.json vs CC-BY-4.0 in README
candidates.license_details: OpenNeuro dataset_description.json declares CC0; README author text specifies CC-BY-4.0. Both sources preserved without silent override.
candidates.participants_stated: EEGDash catalog states 21 subjects. participants.tsv contains excluded and bad_after_preprocessing columns; included cohort count after those exclusion flags is not resolved from catalog text alone. Catalog N is an enrollment upper bound, not analyzed N.
candidates.sessions_stated: OpenNeuro page lists tasks: awake, sed, sed2. Total session count not unified on catalog page.
candidates.behavioral_labels: README describes repeated awakening / dreaming under propofol sedation. Exact event codes not inspected.
candidates.channel_montage_sampling: Inspected sidecar (sub-1010 task-awake acq-EC eeg.json) states SamplingFrequency 5000.0 Hz, EEGChannelCount 65, Manufacturer Brain Products, EEGReference n/a. EEGDash catalog notes mixed 64/65 channel counts across recordings, all 5000 Hz.
candidates.access_restrictions: OpenNeuro public download. Access is not permission to reidentify or redistribute participant data.
candidates.exclusions_or_missingness: participants.tsv has excluded and bad_after_preprocessing columns. Filtered counts remain unverified.
candidates.compatibility: BIDS EEG. Primary reference cohort; cannot serve as an independent replication of itself.

candidates.title: Meditation vs thinking task
candidates.license_details: OpenNeuro v1.0.0 metadata declares CC0 Public Domain Dedication.
candidates.participants_stated: OpenNeuro catalog states 98 participants. Public comment records that participants.tsv contains 24 Himalayan Yoga (HT), 31 Control (CTR), 19 Vipassana (VIP), 20 Isha Shoonya (SNY), and 4 Transcendental Meditation (TM) subjects (total 98), while companion source files note ~100 subjects. Catalog count does not equal analyzed count.
candidates.behavioral_labels: README describes four blocks alternating meditation and active thinking with eyes closed. Block 1 is breath counting for all; block 2 is tradition-specific meditation.
candidates.channel_montage_sampling: BioSemi ActiveTwo 64 channels (standard 10-10 layout) plus external electrodes (mastoids, EOG); sampling rate 1024 Hz confirmed from publisher/NEMAR records.
candidates.access_restrictions: OpenNeuro CC0. Availability is not permission to redistribute derived claims as empirical confirmation.
candidates.exclusions_or_missingness: Participant subgroup count conflict between catalog headline (98) and source documentation (~100); external artifact channels require adapter mapping.
candidates.compatibility: BIDS EEG with task labels. Independent hardware (BioSemi vs Brain Products in ds005620) and non-pharmacological altered state.

candidates.title: Heartbeat-evoked responses and self-reported meditative depth in Vipassana practitioners
candidates.license_details: Verified CC0 on OpenNeuro catalog page as of 2026-10-21.
candidates.participants_stated: OpenNeuro catalog states 39 participants. Experienced Vipassana practitioners. Catalog enrollment is not analyzed N.
candidates.behavioral_labels: Repeated real-time self-reports of meditative depth across meditation blocks (rest, pre-up meditation, SAPO, active oddball, SILENT, cool-down).
candidates.channel_montage_sampling: High-density EEG (64 channels) with concurrent ECG, respiration, EMG, and electrodermal activity (EDA).
candidates.exclusions_or_missingness: Companion peer-reviewed journal article in preparation / not yet indexed.
candidates.compatibility: BIDS EEG with cardiac and respiratory covariates. Enables partialling of autonomic confounders.

candidates.title: EEG meditation study
candidates.participants_stated: README and OpenNeuro catalog state 24 participants. Catalog enrollment is not analyzed N.
candidates.behavioral_labels: README describes meditation interrupted approximately every 2 minutes for concentration and mind-wandering ratings.
candidates.channel_montage_sampling: BioSemi ActiveTwo 80 channels (64 scalp + 16 auxiliary/external); originally recorded at 2048 Hz, downsampled to 256 Hz.
candidates.exclusions_or_missingness: Sample size (N=24) below preferred threshold for held-out split.

candidates.title: The effects of sham hypnosis techniques
candidates.participants_stated: README and catalog state 52 participants (39 females). Published study reports hypnotizability scores available for only 83% of participants (N=43). Catalog N is not analyzed N.
candidates.behavioral_labels: 2x2 balanced placebo design crossing induction technique with framing (hypnosis vs relaxation). Pre/post eyes-closed rest.
candidates.channel_montage_sampling: 64-channel EasyCap from Brain Products. BrainVision format (.vhdr, .vmrk, .eeg).
candidates.access_restrictions: OpenNeuro CC0. Pinned here to v1.3.1 metadata.
candidates.exclusions_or_missingness: Hypnotizability score missingness (17% missing in published cohort analysis).
candidates.compatibility: BIDS EEG with balanced placebo conditions. Evaluates construct generalization across non-pharmacological induction, not propofol replication.

candidates.title: Multimodal EEG-fNIRS data from patients undergoing general anesthesia
candidates.participants_stated: OpenNeuro catalog states 8 participants. Undergoing endoscopic anesthesia. Catalog N=8 is an enrollment upper bound, not analyzed N.
candidates.channel_montage_sampling: EEGDash catalog states channel counts 59, 40, 30, 38 across recordings and sampling rates 1000 Hz and 7.8125 Hz.
candidates.exclusions_or_missingness: N=8. Variable channel counts across subjects.
candidates.compatibility: Too small and heterogeneous for primary replication.

candidates.title: Bitbrain Open Access Sleep Dataset
candidates.license_details: Verified CC0 on OpenNeuro as of 2026-10-21.
candidates.participants_stated: OpenNeuro catalog states 128 participants. README states 128 nights from 100 participants. Discrepancy between catalog N and participant N flagged.
candidates.sessions_stated: OpenNeuro catalog states 1 session; README describes full-night recordings.
candidates.channel_montage_sampling: Micromed Brain Quick Plus Evolution PSG plus Bitbrain wearable headband.
candidates.exclusions_or_missingness: Participant vs night count discrepancy; BIDS validation error flagged on catalog snippet.
candidates.compatibility: Sleep is a distinct neurophysiological construct. Wearable montage is not comparable to high-density propofol EEG without locked channel map.

candidates.title: Using anesthesia-induced loss of consciousness to identify biomarkers of conscious awareness in the healthy human brain
candidates.behavioral_labels: Sedation states: awake, mild, deep, recovery. fMRI modality.
